entry.summary: RT Reclaim The Net Jim Jordan is taking the EU to task over its censorship-heavy Digital Services Act (DSA). In a letter to the EU Commission, he demands answers on how this law will impact US tech companies — especially ongoing investigations into Meta and X. Jordan isn’t playing along with the EU’s framing. He calls out the DSA’s “censorship provisions” and warns that, because global platforms often apply the same rules worldwide, the law could create “de facto global censorship standards.”
